added_failure_note: A figure review runs no suite, so the zero and the empty list are declared rather than measured. No suite delta is claimed.
attachment_note: One rendered image was attached to this review run and was opened with this node's own Read tool before any verdict was formed. It is a 1399x720 RGBA PNG. Attribution is by content, not filename: the reviewed range 7f3db88c11..a086e97535 adds docs/figures/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-lineage-cycle-guard/transaction.svg and no other figure, and the committed caption in docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-lineage-cycle-guard.html describes a transaction that moves sources, locks connected names and checks lineage before merging a safe edge or rolling back. The attached picture is exactly that: a three-step left-to-right chain ('Move sources if required' -> 'Lock connected lineage names' -> 'Check reverse path and self-loop') splitting into 'Merge safe edge' and 'Refuse and roll back the transaction'. No SVG was opened, read, searched, listed, rendered or git-shown by this review, and no image other than the named PNG was opened; every verdict below is read from that PNG's pixels. Measurements were taken with Pillow and numpy against that PNG only.

caption_check.note: The committed figcaption explains what the transaction owns and what a failed check does, so it is not a title restatement.

disposition_note: No disposition is set on these findings: the review is read-only and naming a fold target or an exemption belongs to the coordinator.

rubric.data_ink: PASS. Five text blocks plus four connector strokes, 64 distinct RGB values total, no fills, gradients or shading. The whole drawn content is 1197 x 326 px inside a 1399 x 720 px canvas.
rubric.decoration: PASS. White background, flat monochrome strokes, no grid, frame, shadow or themed styling.

rubric.legibility: PASS. Five labels, each fully drawn: 'Move sources if required' (96,335)-(234,384), 'Lock connected lineage names' (421,334)-(578,384), 'Check reverse path and self-loop' (737,334)-(931,384), 'Merge safe edge' (1120,200)-(1279,218), 'Refuse and roll back the transaction' (1102,488)-(1297,526). Single-line glyph height measures 19 px on a 1399 px canvas, so at a roughly 900 px column the text renders near 12 px, small but readable; recorded as non-blocking finding f1.
rubric.table_form: PASS. A sequential transaction with a merge-or-refuse divergence is a flow, not tabular information drawn as a picture.

findings.summary: The canvas is vertically underused, so the text renders smaller than it needs to. Measured on the attached PNG: the drawn content occupies rows 200-526 of 720 (45.4% of the height), leaving a 200 px empty band above and a 194 px empty band below, while horizontally the content spans 100-1297 of 1399. A single-row diagram on a 7.2 in tall canvas therefore puts 16 pt-equivalent labels at about 12 px in a ~900 px column, below body-text size. A reader can read it, so this does not block; tightening the canvas height to the diagram would let the same content render at a normal size.

The refusal outcome is drawn identically to the success outcome: both branch labels are #262626 text and both branch connectors are #666666 strokes of the same weight. The figure exists to show that a failed cycle check refuses and rolls back, which is its safety-critical branch, yet a reader scanning the split cannot tell which arm refuses without reading both labels in full. Nothing is illegible, so this does not block; a distinct treatment for the refusal arm (weight, dash, or the project's limit colour) would let it read pre-attentively.

The two branch connectors do not meet at a drawn fork. Measured on the PNG, their tails both sit at x 980 but the upper runs y 233-338 and the lower y 380-486, leaving rows 339-379 with no ink in the x 960-1000 column, and no connector joins the preceding label 'Check reverse path and self-loop' (right edge x 931) to that point. The split is still readable as a split because the two diagonals sit under and over the step they follow, but a reader traces two separated diagonals back to the previous step rather than following one drawn fork. Non-blocking.

rubric_lines: RUBRIC legibility: PASS - all five labels render at full text size and read at a glance; the chain then the two-way split is unambiguous. The text is smaller than it needs to be because the diagram uses only rows 200-526 of the 720-row canvas, recorded as non-blocking finding f1.

RUBRIC data_ink: PASS - the ink is five text blocks and four connector strokes on white, nothing else; the 64 distinct RGB values are those flat colours plus their antialiasing edges, with no fills, gradients, bands or shading.
RUBRIC decoration: PASS - plain white background, no gradient, no box or theme styling; every drawn mark carries meaning.

RUBRIC contrast: PASS - labels are #262626 on white (15.1:1) and connectors #666666 (5.7:1), both far above their thresholds; the lighter greys in the palette are glyph and stroke antialiasing, not separate marks.
RUBRIC table_form: PASS - the content is an ordered three-step flow with one two-way outcome, which is correctly a diagram rather than information that belongs in a table.

RUBRIC label_collision: PASS - the five label boxes are disjoint (nearest pair 'Merge safe edge' at y 200-218 and the upper connector ending at y 233, a 15 px gap), no label touches a stroke (closest approach 30.3 px), and the content bounding box 100-1297 x 200-526 sits wholly inside the 1399x720 canvas.
